lines.text: The prophet warns Ahab about spring, and Ben-hadad then mobilizes the Arameans and goes up to Megiddo to fight Israel.
The LORD delivers the great army to Israel, who strike down a hundred thousand foot soldiers in one day.
Ben-hadad hides in an inner room, his servants wear sackcloth and ropes, and Ahab makes a treaty with him.
A prophet's companion refuses to strike him and a bear kills him, but a second man strikes the prophet.
The prophet says Ahab's life will be exchanged for Ben-hadad's, and the king goes home to Samaria sullen and angry.
